title: You don't lose friends. You stop *practicing*

label: AGE 22
head: Friends are automatic
sub: Same dorm, same team, same bar every Friday. Zero effort needed.

label: AGE 28
head: Career and girlfriend come first
sub: The group chat goes quiet. Nobody plans anything.

label: AGE 35
head: Kids, mortgage, no time
sub: You see your best friend at weddings. Maybe.

label: AGE 60
head: 300 contacts, 0 close friends
sub: Your wife plans your social life. You call it fine.

text: Men don't get worse at friendship. They *stop practicing* it.

items.head: Book a standing night
items.sub: First Thursday of the month. Same place. Nobody has to plan.

items.head: Be the one who texts first
items.sub: Send the photo, the meme, the "you still lifting?"
